newsitem.title: USA: Cargill to open Mexico soy crushing plant Feb 3.
newsitem.headline: Cargill to open Mexico soy crushing plant Feb 3.

text.p: Cargill Inc said it would open its new $30 million soybean processing plant at Tula, Hidalgo, in Mexico on February 3.
The plant is designed to process 1,500 tonnes of mainly U.S.-grown soybeans per day to produce soyoil and soymeal for the domestic Mexican market, Cargill said.
The facility is located adjacent to Cargill's Atitalaquia corn syrup distribution center, 60 miles north of Mexico City.
The plant is operated by Cargill de Mexico, which markets seed, feed grains, fertilizer, vegetable oils, corn syrup and financial services. It also processes and sells meat products.
